data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘halos’, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘noblewoman’. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Halda usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, noblewoman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
